The complete design corpus for the Buddy CPaaS build: the sealed table canon, every
architecture decision (ADR 0001–0021), the design docs, per-module build guides,
and the system diagrams.

::: {.callout-note title="This site is temporary — by design"}
This Quarto site is the **single source of truth for the corpus until phase-1 code
starts landing in clairvoyance**. At that point `modules/` and `decisions/` migrate
into `clairvoyance/docs/crm/` (so guide-changes ship in the same PR as code), and this
site retires or becomes a rendered mirror. Decided 2026-08-21.
:::

## Day-1 reading order (≈ 30 minutes to productive)

1. **[The master system map](diagrams/d00-master.qmd)** — the whole machine on one
   canvas. Facts flow left to right; commands take the sync door; consequences
   re-enter as facts.
2. **[Module rules](modules/00-module-rules.md)** — the laws EVERY module obeys, each
   traced to a scar we already have.
3. **Your module's build guide + diagram** — how to build it, how NOT to build it:
   [record](modules/01-record.md) · [identity](modules/02-identity.md) ·
   [permission](modules/03-permission.md) · [connectivity](modules/04-connectivity.md) ·
   [outreach](modules/05-outreach.md) · [conversations/inbox](modules/06-conversations-inbox.md)
4. **[The task map](design/task-map.md)** — pods, phases, dependencies, milestones.
   The Slack CPAAS list is the work surface; this map is its source of truth.
5. When you disagree with a rule: **[the ADRs](decisions/README.md)** are the why.
   Nothing here is taste — every rule has a decision record behind it.

## The phases (ADR 0016)

| Phase | Ships |
|---|---|
| **0** | PgBouncer · fail-closed DND · migration CI · reseller backfill · small fixes |
| **1** | Customers end-to-end WITH UI · WhatsApp transactional outbound · the event spine · journey view (voice included, ADR 0017) |
| **2** | Static flows (walker, click branching) · segments · broadcast · flow-builder UI |
| **3** | WhatsApp inbound · the AI agent plugin · the team inbox · customer memory · Instagram |

## The one-sentence architecture

**Edges translate · the spine records · bridges call contracts · contracts write** —
and every outbound, from any source, passes one fail-closed gate and lands on one
manifest.
